preconditions.description: The total number of nodes n is between 3 and 200,000.
The number of exit-nodes k is between 2 and n-1.

postconditions.description: The first line of the output is the minimum possible distance between the two most distant exit-nodes.
There are exactly n-1 lines describing the connections between nodes.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in return_value[1:])
postconditions.description: Each connection involves valid node IDs between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: len(set(u for u, _ in return_value[1:]) | set(v for _, v in return_value[1:])) == n
postconditions.description: All n nodes are included in the connections.

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for u, v in return_value[1:] if u in exit_nodes or v in exit_nodes) == k
postconditions.description: Exactly k nodes are exit-nodes, each connected to exactly one other node.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(1 for u, v in return_value[1:] if u == node or v == node) >= 2 for node in range(1, n + 1) if node not in exit_nodes)
postconditions.description: All non-exit nodes are connected to at least two other nodes.
